title: generate delta upgrade index and SBOM stamping for private-installer CI
author: Ethan Park
description: This PR adds a CI-first pipeline to produce deterministic delta upgrade packages and stamp SBOM/provenance metadata into the private-installer release artifacts. Motivation: customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) need compact upgrade bundles and a verifiable upgrade graph so operators can perform safe roll-forwards and rollbacks without re-pulling full images. The output of the pipeline is a signed delta-index (delta-index.json) that expresses available upgrade paths between installer versions and references per-artifact SBOMs, Helm chart lockfiles, and Terraform module plan snapshots. Changes include: 1) new pipeline job (private-installer:delta-pack) that builds compact tarballs containing only changed manifests and image digests; 2) delta-indexer tool (tools/release/delta-indexer.go) which computes graph edges and emits SBOM references; 3) SBOM stamping step using syft and a lightweight metadata envelope; 4) cosign/cosign-wrapper integration to attach OCI signatures and timestamped provenance to each delta bundle; 5) Helm chart lockfile generator (charts/lockfiles/) and Terraform module plan snapshotter (terraform/modules/plan-snapshots/); 6) makefile and CI matrix additions to validate deltas with a staging smoke deploy and terraform plan dry-run. Checklist: - [x] implement delta-index format and generator - [x] wire up CI job and pipeline config - [x] add SBOM generation and envelope signing - [x] add unit tests for indexer and SBOM parsing - [x] add e2e smoke test in staging workflow - [x] document format and CLI usage in docs/release/delta-index.md Backwards compatibility: existing full-installer artifacts and release flow are unchanged; the delta-index is additive and consumed by the private-installer CLI/upgrade controller. Note on security: SBOMs are generated with syft v0.83.0 and emitted alongside artifacts; cosign keys are stored in the CI KMS and rotated per release cadence. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and gating criteria.

release_notes: Introduce delta-index (delta-index.json) for private-installer releases: smaller upgrade bundles, SBOMs per delta, signed provenance, Helm/Terraform lockfiles. Operators can use the index to compute safe upgrade paths and perform rollbacks more quickly.
notes_for_ops: To consume deltas, upgrade private-installer CLI >= v0.23 which understands delta-index.json. CI publishes both full and delta artifacts; by default the installer will prefer delta bundles when ancestry is available. For emergency rollback, use --force-apply with a specific delta bundle digest from the index.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for delta graph computation and SBOM envelope parsing. CI runs: 2x matrix builds (linux/amd64 linux/arm64), staging smoke deploy succeeded, terraform dry-run validated. Flaky test (e2e network teardown) was re-run and passed on the second attempt.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: consumers may accidentally apply a partial delta for mismatched base versions. Mitigation: delta-index includes base-version constraint checks and the installer will refuse mismatched deltas. CI includes a gating smoke deploy and signature verification to prevent unsigned deltas from reaching stable. Added audit log events for delta apply/rollback.
